tasks.title: Real route/map: routing provider port, actual geometry rendering, tiles and attribution
tasks.goal: Add a RoutingProvider port with adapters (OSRM recorded responses first) so a live navigation suggestion carries destination, geometry, ETA, timestamp/source and refresh; the map strip decodes and draws the ACTUAL route polyline with mandatory provider/tile attribution (OSM tile usage policy). Without destination, authorized location, or provider geometry, Live shows 'no route available'; the Demo route stays SIMULATED. External-map handoff allowed only when honestly labelled as a handoff.

tasks.title: OWNER GATE G-ROUTE: routing provider, cost cap, ToS acceptance
tasks.goal: Owner decision only: choose the live routing provider (accept OSRM demo-server limits, or register an OpenRouteService free key server-side, or a billed Mapbox/Google account), accept its ToS and any cost cap, and accept the tile provider terms. Terminal states: DONE, or DECLINED (recorded) - declined keeps Live at 'no route available' with the Demo route behind ?dev=1, and nothing is blocked retroactively.
tasks.owner_gate: G-ROUTE: owner names the routing provider, accepts ToS/cost cap and tile terms; never assumed, no key handled by agents beyond server-side placement the owner authorizes
checks: Owner decision recorded verbatim (provider, ToS acceptance, cost cap, date); without it no live routing call is enabled
python .progress/scripts/emit_convergence_event.py task_complete --task-id GATE-ROUTE --plan-ref docs/architecture/REV3_LIVE_ROADMAP.plan.json

Each feature is either accepted on that evidence or explicitly reported BLOCKED on its gate - recorded-fixture green never counts as live-done.
tasks.owner_gate: G-LIVE-RUN: owner authorizes the real-run session (location consent on the device, any billed usage inside the G-ROUTE cap) and gives the per-viewport visual sign-off
